gradcam.prediction_agreement: Neural and SVM heads agreed on all 20 sampled images and were jointly correct on 19/20.
gradcam.interpretation: Correct classification often coexisted with poor/off-lesion saliency; maps are coarse contribution maps, not tumor boundaries or proof of clinically valid reasoning.

occlusion.notable_case: Te-pi_0078.jpg: 38/169 flips = 22.5%, consistent with instability around the shared misclassification.
occlusion.interpretation: Final-SVM occlusion directly probes the deployed classifier path, but maps remain qualitative and independently normalized; vivid color need not imply large absolute score change.
